{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out sentinel values in baseline
valid_baseline = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Identify re-tested patients (those with multiple sample_seq entries)
patient_sample_seq = valid_baseline.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
retested_patients = patient_sample_seq[patient_sample_seq > 1].index

# Step 3: Exclude re-tested patients from analysis
# Only keep patients with sample_seq == 1 (i.e., not re-tested)
non_retested = valid_baseline[valid_baseline['sample_seq'] == 1]

# Step 4: Convert batch-B biomarker_final to ng/mL (divide by 10)
non_retested = non_retested.copy()
non_retested.loc[non_retested['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 5: Compute change in biomarker (final - baseline)
non_retested['biomarker_change'] = non_retested['biomarker_final'] - non_retested['biomarker_baseline']

# Step 6: Compute average change
avg_change = non_retested['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of non-re-tested patients with valid baseline: {len(non_retested)}")
print(f"Average biomarker change (ng/mL): {avg_change:.2f}")"}
